is-crawlable.title: Page isn't blocked from indexing
is-crawlable.tip: Ensures no noindex directive blocks Google from indexing this URL.

document-title.title: Document has a <title> element
document-title.tip: The title tag is the most important on-page signal for search rankings.

meta-description.title: Document has a meta description
meta-description.tip: Summarizes your page in search snippets to improve click-through rate.

http-status-code.title: Valid HTTP status code (200)
http-status-code.tip: Confirms the page loads cleanly without 4xx or 5xx errors.

link-text.title: Links have descriptive text
link-text.tip: Avoid generic anchor text like 'click here'; use clear keywords.

crawlable-anchors.title: Links are crawlable
crawlable-anchors.tip: Use real <a href='...'> links so Google can discover internal pages.

robots-txt.title: robots.txt is valid
robots-txt.tip: Checks that robots.txt has valid syntax and allows crawling.

image-alt.title: Image elements have [alt] attributes
image-alt.tip: Helps Google Images understand your photos and improves accessibility.

hreflang.title: Document has valid hreflang
hreflang.tip: Tells Google which language version (ES, EN, etc.) to serve users.

canonical.title: Valid rel=canonical URL
canonical.tip: Prevents duplicate content by pointing to the official URL.

viewport.title: Mobile viewport meta tag present
viewport.tip: Ensures the layout scales properly on mobile devices.

structured-data.title: Structured data (Schema JSON-LD)
structured-data.tip: Enables rich snippets (stars, FAQs, business info) in search results.
